g.text: c Frozen heads strongly redirect synthetic and real-filing answers

text.style: font-size: 7px; font-family: 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #4d4d4d

g.text: Top: synthetic H7, 8 seeds × 64; bottom: real 10-K H10b, 4 groups × 64 per direction. Labels are counts / 64.

text.style: font-size: 7px; font-family: 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #4d4d4d

g.text: H7 uses the frozen unique-integer parser and fails its strict validity gate. H10b uses its separately registered decimal parser.

text.style: font-size: 7px; font-family: 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #4d4d4d

g.text: Red: frozen 8 heads Blue: maximum of the same 100 layer-matched random sets
